question: Question linked to image # 12 What is the most reasonable attitude at this time ?:

options.opa: Remove the entire catheter and reinsert it.
options.opb: Extract about 10 cm the catheter and install the appropriate treatment.
options.opc: Channel another central venous line through the jugular vein.
options.opd: Leave it as it is because it can be used to monitor central venous pressure.
options.ope: We can not use the catheter because it has perforated the vein and it is located in the lung.
